messages:
pagerbot: P0 ALERT — outbound log-forwarder traffic to unknown external endpoints detected from inference-runtime cluster. Alert ID PB-4821. Potential leaked debug snippets (auth headers, session_ids). Initial spike observed earlier.

maria: looking. which cluster? link to sample logs?

dave: seeing same. IPs: 52.184.12.99 / 34.120.45.210 - both uncommon. logs show `DEBUG: forwarder POST https://api.external-collector/v1/logs` with partial auth fragments.

linda: I'm oncall, pulling runbook. Maria, can you temporarily disable forwarding and block egress for the forwarder pods? ben please stand by for key rotation.

maria: running: ```kubectl -n inference rollout pause deploy/log-forwarder && kubectl -n inference scale deploy/log-forwarder --replicas=0``` doing now.

ben: starting egress block at network ACL level for those IPs and adding deny rule on prod-egress-sg. Applying WAF deny on path /v1/logs as well.

dave: good. Collect and preserve evidence — snapshot current forwarder config and logs to secure bucket (kms=redwood-sec). Use write-once retention. Create ticket for potential PII exposure.

maria: saved config to s3://sec-evidence/PB-4821/config-1748889991.tar.gz (access restricted). Also saved a 1hr log window.

linda: initial customer impact: no degraded inference latency, only telemetry path affected. Customers might have had debug logs sent externally — need outreach if PII confirmed. @ben can you confirm which service account keys are used by forwarder?

ben: forwarder uses svcacct: log-forwarder-sa -> GCP service account infra-log-writer@redwood-inference. I'll rotate keys and create new SA key. Plan: 1) create new SA 2) issue new key 3) patch forwarder env var 4) verify then deprecate old key.

dave: prioritize rotation. Also run quick search for email/ssn patterns in captured payloads. If any hit, escalate to legal.

legal-bot: Legal notified. Please collect scope (customer IDs, timestamps). Use protected channel #legal-incident for any PHI/PII findings.

maria: rotation prep: generating new service account and key (staging test first). Command: ```gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new-key.json --iam-account=infra-log-writer@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com``` will not deploy until verified.

ben: deployed new key to staging forwarder, smoke tests pass. Scheduling deploy to prod under Linda's ok.

linda: proceed with controlled rollout to prod after we confirm no exfil to allowlist. Delta rollout 50% then 100%.

ben: prod patch applied, forwarder back up but with egress to collector disabled. Confirming no outbound to 52.184.12.99/34.120.45.210.

maria: confirming: forwarder pods running, no external POSTs in last 5m. logs show local buffering.

dave: completed initial scan of captured payloads — low-confidence hits for user identifiers, no clear SSNs. We'll run extended pattern matching and DLP scan.

legal-bot: prepare customer notification template but hold until security confirms PII exposure. Notify compliance.

ben: rotated keys and revoked old key: action completed at 1748890800.

linda: great. Action items: (1) security extended scan (dave) (2) customer impact assessment (cs-team) (3) preserve evidence and handoff to forensics (maria+ben) (4) postmortem draft (owner: dave). ETA preliminary report 6h.

dave: ack. starting deeper logs analysis and scheduling forensics handoff now.

maria: evidence archived and write-protected. Snapshot IDs: s3://sec-evidence/PB-4821/{logs,config,network-trace}.md5 saved.

ben: firewall deny rules still in place for 52.184.12.99 & 34.120.45.210. Will keep for 72h unless security says otherwise.

linda: assigning follow-ups and moving to incident bridge. If anything customer-impacting found, escalate to @cto and start external comms.

dave: preliminary findings will be in #security-ops and updated here. Thanks everyone.

pagerbot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigations applied, severity downgraded to P1 pending scan results. Incident ticket PB-4821 updated. Moving active coordination to bridge and #security-ops forensics.
